mapper.sql: pmio.id id,pmio.org_id orgId,pmio.patient_id patientId,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.master_card masterCard,pmio.card_number cardNumber, pmio.status status,pmio.principal_amount principalAmount,pmio.bonus_amount bonusAmount,pmio.point point,pmio.last_expired_time lastExpiredTime, pmio.next_expired_time nextExpiredTime,pmio.remarks remarks,pmio.inservice inservice, pmio.nonauto nonauto, pmio.min_type_id minTypeId
mapper.select: select pmio.org_id orgId, pmio.patient_id patientId, pmio.id,pmio.card_number cardNumber,pmio.member_type_id memberTypeId,pmio.crt_time crtTime,pbio.name name, CAST((pmio.principal_amount+pmio.bonus_amount) AS decimal(15,4)) memberCardMoneySum, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.principal_amount,0) AS decimal(15,4)) principalAmount, CAST(IFNULL(pmio.bonus_amount,0) AS decimal(15,4)) bonusAmount, pmio.inservice from patient_member_info pmio join patient_base_info pbio on pmio.patient_id = pbio.id where pmio.patient_id =#{id}

select pmr.id bindId,(select name from patient_base_info where id = pmr.secondary_card_id )name,pmr.master_card_id masterCardId, pmr.secondary_card_id secondaryCardId,pmr.bind_type bindType,pbi.face_url as faceUrl, pbi.mobile AS masterMobile from patient_member_relation pmr join patient_base_info pbi on pmr.master_card_id = pbi.id where pmr.master_card_id = #{form.patientId} and bind_type = #{form.bindType}
select IF(card_number is null,'000000',substr( MAX(card_number), -6, 6 )) as maxnum from patient_member_info where left(card_number,1)='H' and org_id = #{orgId}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{cardNumber}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.card_number = #{memberCard}
select pbi.name from patient_member_info pmio left join patient_base_info pbi on pmio.patient_id = pbi.id where pmio.card_number = #{memberCard}

select
from patient_member_info pmio where pmio.patient_id =#{patientId}

SELECT pmi.id, pmr.master_card_id AS patientId, pbi.`name`, pmi.member_type_id AS memberTypeId, pmi.card_number AS cardNumber, pmi.inservice, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.principal_amount + pmi.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 4 )) memberCardMoneySum, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.principal_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 4 )) principalAmount, CAST( IFNULL( pmi.bonus_amount, 0 ) AS DECIMAL ( 15, 4 )) bonusAmount FROM ( SELECT pmr.master_card_id FROM patient_member_relation pmr WHERE bind_type = 1 AND pmr.secondary_card_id = #{patientId} GROUP BY pmr.master_card_id ) pmr INNER JOIN patient_member_info pmi ON pmr.master_card_id = pmi.patient_id LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON pmr.master_card_id = pbi.id

SELECT t.*, pbi.name AS patientName FROM ( SELECT pmi.card_number AS cardNumber, pmi.patient_id AS patientId, 0 AS type, pmi.principal_amount + pmi.bonus_amount AS balance, IFNULL(mer.principal, 0) AS principal, IFNULL(mer.bonus, 0) AS bonus FROM ( SELECT member_id, order_record_id, SUM(expend_principal) AS principal, SUM(expend_gift) AS bonus FROM member_expend_record WHERE inservice = true GROUP BY member_id, order_record_id ) mer LEFT JOIN patient_member_info pmi ON pmi.card_number = mer.member_id WHERE mer.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId} UNION ALL SELECT pmi.prepayment_number AS cardNumber, pmi.patient_id AS patientId, 1 AS type, pmi.prepayment_principal + pmi.prepayment_bonus AS balance, IFNULL(mer.principal, 0) AS principal, IFNULL(mer.bonus, 0) AS bonus FROM ( SELECT prepaid_id, order_record_id, SUM(expend_principal) AS principal, SUM(expend_gift) AS bonus FROM prepaid_expend_record WHERE inservice = true GROUP BY prepaid_id, order_record_id ) mer LEFT JOIN patient_prepayments_info pmi ON pmi.prepayment_number = mer.prepaid_id WHERE mer.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId} ) t LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON pbi.id = t.patientId

SELECT IFNULL(mer.cardCumulativeConsumption, 0) AS cardCumulativeConsumption, IFNULL(pmi.principal_amount, 0) AS memberPrincipal, IFNULL(pmi.bonus_amount, 0) AS memberBouns, IFNULL(pmi.bonus_amount, 0) AS personBounsCumulative FROM patient_member_info pmi LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, SUM(expend_principal + expend_gift) AS cardCumulativeConsumption FROM member_expend_record GROUP BY member_id ) mer ON pmi.card_number=mer.member_id WHERE pmi.patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT
, 'true' AS remark FROM patient_member_relation pmr INNER JOIN patient_member_info pmio ON pmio.patient_id = pmr.master_card_id WHERE pmr.bind_type = 1 AND pmr.inservice = 1 AND pmr.secondary_card_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY pmr.crt_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT , 'true' AS remark FROM ( SELECT pmi.* FROM patient_kin_relation pkr LEFT JOIN patient_member_info pmi ON pmi.patient_id = pkr.patient_id WHERE pkr.type = 1 AND pkr.inservice = 1 AND pmi.inservice = 1 AND pkr.linked_patient_id = #{patientId} ) pmio LEFT JOIN patient_base_info pbi ON pmio.patient_id = pbi.id WHERE pbi.inservice = 1
